Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I hope the mistake done to my order gets resolved](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6452b1d5746ca7dfea15d805)
Hi, I am not one to write a negative review. However, I purchased two orders both had two mirrors the Anastasia mirror and the Rook mirrors, both by Sarah Samuel Sherman, and they were reflecting a price that apparently was not correct because there was a glitch on the website, and so my order got canceled and now I am not getting the mirrors I ordered. The worse thing is that they are not honoring the price that was reflected on the order. I sent an email three days ago and I have not heard back from them. I am hoping they honor the price on the website and they maintain the integrity of the price shown in the website. Like I said, I have had great costumer service with Lulu and Georgia so I am hoping they resolve this mistake. 

Thank you.

April 26, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 4, 2023

Hi Silvia,

We thank you for reaching out. We're sorry to hear about your experience with us. We see one of our representatives has been assisting you on this issue and figuring out further options for you. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
